groups.instructions: Complete each sentence with ONE word from the word list.

questions.prompt: Sitting at a desk all day is a ________ lifestyle.
questions.explanation: See the word list entry for the phrase containing 'sedentary'.

questions.prompt: Thanks to better medicine, life ________ has increased.
questions.explanation: See the word list entry for the phrase containing 'expectancy'.

questions.prompt: Asthma is a ________ condition that lasts for years.
questions.explanation: See the word list entry for the phrase containing 'chronic'.

questions.prompt: Excessive screen use may have a ________ effect on sleep.
questions.explanation: See the word list entry for the phrase containing 'detrimental'.

questions.prompt: Exercise benefits mental ________ as well as physical health.
questions.explanation: See the word list entry for the phrase containing 'well-being'.

questions.prompt: Many nurses suffer from ________ after years of night shifts.
questions.explanation: See the word list entry for the phrase containing 'burnout'.

groups.instructions: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.explanation: Maintain / eat / follow a balanced diet.

questions.prompt: Which word describes a disease that can be avoided?
questions.explanation: Preventable disease = it can be prevented.
